messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER - metering.billing.emit_wave detected. Metric: token_count_drift=7.2% over 20m, delayed_emit_rate spike. IncidentID=7bf4. Severity=P1. Dashboard: https://ops.redwood/incidents/7bf4
oncall-sre: I'm on it. Kicking off triage. @Maria (Billing) please confirm if billing pipeline seeing delayed reports or phantom overages. @Jake (Infra) can you check emitter fleet health and Kafka consumer lag?
Maria (Billing): confirmed - elevated late_usage_reports in us-west and eu-west. A small set of auto_overage flags fired (~12 customers). Pulling customer list now.
Jake (Infra): quick check - emitter-prod-eu shows repeated OOMs after last mem-tweak. Logs snippet: `OOMKilled: process=emitter pid=4512 shard=eu-12 memory=5.2GiB` Looks like memory cap too low for new shard packing. Starting rolling restart for eu-12.
Emma (SRE): toggled billing.alerts.suppress_overage=true for 30m to avoid noisy emails while we investigate. Posting statuspage banner. :loudspeaker:
Sam (Customer Success): drafting holding message: "We're investigating billing visibility and will not charge customers for anomalies while we reconcile." Sending to Legal for quick review. Will circle back.
billing-ingest-bot: Scheduled BACKFILL job BACKFILL-7BF4 for 24h window (reason: delayed emitter deliveries). Estimated runtime ~40-60m. Progress updates will be posted here.
oncall-sre: Triage plan: 1) stabilize emitters (Jake), 2) suppress noisy alerts (Emma), 3) run backfill (billing-ingest-bot), 4) reconcile and issue credits if needed (Maria). I'll update every 8-10m. Ownership: Jake=infra RCA + rollback of mem bump, Maria=reconciliation & credits, Emma=alerts & comms.
Maria (Billing): FYI two customers already received automated overage emails before suppression. Preparing credit workflow and customer list now. Attaching brief table in follow-up post.
Jake (Infra): restart complete for emitter-prod-eu eu-12. Command used: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/emitter-prod --namespace=eu --selector=shard=12` Kafka consumer lag reduced from ~11k -> ~900 within 5m. Observing normal token ingress.
oncall-sre: dashboards trending back to normal. Waiting for backfill to finish and then we'll reconcile counts vs emitted. Reminder: add a note to runbook that the mem-config change caused OOM on packed shards.
billing-runbook-bot: Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/metering-emitters. Action added: revert mem-tweak, monitor heap growth for 2h, escalate to eng-runtime if re-occurs.
billing-ingest-bot: BACKFILL-7BF4 status=queued -> running. ETA to completion ~38m. Will log per-10% progress here.
Maria (Billing): backfill started. Initial diff shows expected count delta ~0.6% for affected window; will generate final reconcile once complete and propose credits where customers saw overages.
oncall-sre: once backfill reconciliation validates, we'll: 1) clear suppress flag, 2) retract auto-overage flags, 3) notify affected customers with credit confirmation and post-incident summary.
incident-bot: Incident 7bf4 status=mitigated_partial - emitters stabilized, backfill in progress, suppression active. Next automated check-in at 1799902400.
note: Keep thread concise; most messages are short. This thread documents on-call coordination, quick mitigations (suppress alerts, rolling restarts), backfill scheduling, and customer-impact handling for a token/count drift incident.
